svg.title: Superstore South region: $391,722 sales, $46,749 profit, 11.9% profit ratio; Tennessee, North Carolina and Florida lose money.
svg.desc: Executive profitability dashboard for the South region, orders from January 2023 to December 2026. Sales total $391,722, the lowest of the four regions, with $46,749 profit, an 11.9% profit ratio, an average discount of 14.73% and 6,209 items sold. Tennessee, North Carolina and Florida appear in orange with negative profit ratios, while the other southern states are profitable.
